1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 4 m de longitud, con boca pequeña, dos aletas dorsales, cinco aperturas branquiales y piel sin escamas, de color rojizo. (Ginglymostomatidae; Ginglymostoma cirratum).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 4 meters in length, with a small mouth, two dorsal fins, five gill slits, and skin without scales, of reddish color (family Ginglymostomatidae; species Ginglymostoma cirratum).
